pure-announcement.rationale: It is an educational essay on reliability principles, not a product, release, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The supplied nearest concepts cover retrieval evals and MCP governance; the corpus has no note on general reliability-engineering principles.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Its claims (redundancy buys resilience, blameless postmortems increase reporting, test under realistic load) are standard SRE practice checkable against well-known industry literature even though the essay cites almost none of it.

durability.rationale: The content is deliberately timeless — weakest-link thinking, defect compounding, redundancy trade-offs — with no version, price, or vendor pinning to age out.

actionability.rationale: It restates familiar reliability folk wisdom at a generality ('invest in redundancy', 'test realistically') that gives a practising engineer no mechanism, threshold, or design rule they do not already have.

atomicity.rationale: It is a listicle of seven loosely-joined principles whose only unifying thread — manufacturing lessons transfer to software — is framing rather than a single extractable idea.
